images.prompt: Traditional Japanese sumi-e ink wash painting on aged cream rice paper, bold black brush strokes and splatter, one vermilion red accent. A lone samurai kneeling and writing giant calligraphy strokes on a huge scroll using the tip of his katana dipped in ink as a brush, ink flying off the blade like a storm, strange and powerful, generous empty paper at the top. Leave the top third of the frame empty and calm for a headline. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.
